sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: Software engineer with a focus on AI integration, API and backend development. I have been building software for over 15 years, first through volunteer open-source and community projects and professionally since 2019, using PHP/Laravel and TypeScript, from greenfield architecture through CI/CD to test automation. Over the last two years I have integrated LLMs into real development workflows: designing AI agents, engineering prompts, and optimizing token usage and cost, using the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and MCP. I like to understand a system end-to-end, measure the results, and keep improving it. Currently deepening Python for AI work and learning RAG and vector databases.

sections.heading: SKILLS
lines: AI & LLM Engineering: Agentic AI, AI Agents, LLM integration, Prompt Engineering, MCP, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, AI workflow design, token & cost optimization, AI-assisted development (Claude Code)
Backend: PHP (OOP), Laravel, Laravel Sanctum, Symfony, REST APIs, API Platform, OpenAPI, JWT, Guzzle, Mercure/SSE, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis
Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue.js, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS
Python & Data: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, NumPy, Numba (JIT), pytest, backtesting, data pipelines, algorithm optimization

Architecture & Quality: Software Architecture, System Design, DDD, Event-Driven Architecture, SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code, Requirements Engineering, PHPUnit, BDD (Behat/Gherkin, Pest), Static Analysis (PHPStan level 9), Performance Optimization, Security
DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, DDEV, GitLab CI/CD, Git, Linux, Apache, Composer, npm
Currently learning: RAG, vector databases, embeddings

items.title: AI-Assisted Web Development
bullets: Core contributor (top-3 of a ~7-person team) on an existing greenfield restaurant point-of-sale platform: a distributed system (central Laravel/Filament cloud back-office, on-premise location servers, Capacitor/TypeScript terminals) built on a Domain-Driven, package-oriented Laravel monolith.

Built an internal AI-assisted code-audit tooling suite (Claude Code slash-commands and subagents with deterministic verification) for soft-delete, CRUD-logging, and field-permission audits; integrated AI tools into daily development.

Designed and owns the platform's external REST API end-to-end (API Platform on Laravel) with multi-tenant, permission-scoped access control: row-level query extensions, tenant-isolation write guards, JWT-based API credentials, and OpenAPI documentation.

Designed and implemented the real-time pivot-event synchronization mechanism (a custom laravel-pivot-events package plus a dedicated PivotEvents domain, pushed via Mercure/SSE) within an event-driven architecture backed by Redis queues (Laravel Horizon) and Laravel Octane.
Authored automated tests across the stack (PHPUnit, BDD with Behat/Gherkin and Pest, Selenium, Bruno) within a GitLab CI pipeline enforcing PHPStan level 9 (Larastan) and ECS.

items.title: AI-Assisted Web Development
bullets: Independently planned, built, and maintained web applications, including ticketing systems, websites, and marketing tools.
Used AI tools productively for code analysis, architectural design, code generation, and automation.
Conceived requirements-appropriate custom software and designed the underlying database systems.
Automated tests with PHPUnit and documented code with PHPDoc; coordinated projects and communicated directly with clients.

items.title: Development & Coordination
bullets: Major contributor on a multi-developer team building a long-running PHP browser game (volunteer); modernizing a historically-grown codebase toward Symfony and Doctrine ORM (incl. migrations).
Analyzing and refactoring complex legacy structures while preserving the existing architecture; coordinating a ~10-person team.

items.title: AI Engineering Experiments
bullets: Built and evaluated AI workflows, agents, and integrations to move from prompt experiments toward practical, production-oriented use of LLMs.
Designed agent workflows and orchestrated multi-step tasks with the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and MCP.
Optimized prompts and token usage, weighing cost against output quality.
Compared model strengths and weaknesses to choose the right model per task.

items.title: Trading Research & Backtesting Platform
bullets: Designed and built an algorithmic trading and backtesting system in Python on the event-driven NautilusTrader framework, including walk-forward validation and Monte Carlo portfolio simulation.
Performance engineering: evaluated very large parameter spaces via vectorization and JIT compilation (NumPy, Numba) instead of brute-force loops.
Built a distributed signal-trading system (FastAPI dashboard, multiple Docker containers, MetaTrader 5 integration) with a multi-gate risk-management pipeline and test coverage (pytest).

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events - custom-IDs feature (open-source contribution)
bullets: Extended an existing open-source Laravel package with support for custom IDs and timestamps on pivot tables; worked within its Eloquent relationship internals (BelongsToMany/MorphToMany, model events).
